risks.note: Explicitly listed by management as a business risk. The Company's core business is importing premium marble and natural stone, so landed cost and margin move with the rupee; the cautionary statement also names foreign exchange fluctuations among factors that could cause actual results to differ materially.

Named as a business risk and again in the industry-structure section: the marble industry saw fluctuations in freight costs and disruptions in global supply chains from geopolitical developments, which directly affect an import-led model shipping stone from 30 countries.
risks.risk: Volatility in freight and logistics costs and global supply-chain disruption

risks.note: Listed as a business risk. Since the product range is dominated by imported Italian and exotic marble and granite, any change in import duty or regulation hits cost structure and competitiveness.
risks.risk: Changes in import regulations and duties

risks.note: Listed as a business risk. Demand is concentrated in luxury residential, commercial, hospitality and premium interiors, so a downturn in real estate or infrastructure spending directly reduces offtake; management notes external factors already affected short-term growth in FY2025-26 after a prior year of strong residential and commercial demand.
risks.risk: Slowdown in the real estate and infrastructure sectors
